notes: Two isnads for one saying (the second begins «وحدثنا علي بن عبد الله» with no «ح»), so two groups with null tails. «أو سمعته منه» is the narrator's own doubt about whether he heard it from Uqba; it is noted, not written as a link.
«قال سمعت ابن أبي مليكة» makes Ibn Abi Mulayka a link (rule 5).
